name: IsLocalRing.exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem
statement:
theorem exists_ord_span_eq_ordElem {S : Set R} (hS : S.Finite) (hne : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ f ∈ S, ord (Ideal.span S) = ordElem f

name: IsLocalRing.le_ord_iff
statement: theorem le_ord_iff {I : Ideal R} {r : ℕ} : (r : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I ↔ I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ r

name: IsLocalRing.le_ord_mul
statement: theorem le_ord_mul (I J : Ideal R) : ord I + ord J ≤ ord (I * J)

name: IsLocalRing.le_ord_of_le
statement: theorem le_ord_of_le {I : Ideal R} {r : ℕ} (h : I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ r) : (r : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I

name: IsLocalRing.le_ord_pow
statement: theorem le_ord_pow (I : Ideal R) (c : ℕ) : (c : ℕ∞) * ord I ≤ ord (I ^ c)

name: IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_le_ordElem {f : R} {r : ℕ} :
    f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ r ↔ (r : ℕ∞) ≤ ordElem f

name: IsLocalRing.one_le_ordElem_iff
statement: theorem one_le_ordElem_iff {f : R} : 1 ≤ ordElem f ↔ f ∈ maximalIdeal R

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem ordElem_eq_one_iff {f : R} :
    ordElem f = 1 ↔ f ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ f ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem ordElem_eq_top_iff {f : R} : ordElem f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_one
statement: theorem ordElem_one : ordElem (1 : R) = 0

name: IsLocalRing.ordElem_pow_of_ordElem_mul
statement:
theorem ordElem_pow_of_ordElem_mul
    (hmul : ∀ f g : R, ordElem (f * g) = ordElem f + ordElem g) (f : R) (n : ℕ) :
    ordElem (f ^ n) = (n : ℕ∞) * ordElem f

name: IsLocalRing.ord_anti
statement: theorem ord_anti {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : ord J ≤ ord I

name: IsLocalRing.ord_bot
statement: theorem ord_bot : ord (⊥ : Ideal R) = ⊤

name: IsLocalRing.ord_eq_iInf
statement: theorem ord_eq_iInf (I : Ideal R) : ord I = ⨅ f ∈ I, ordElem f

name: IsLocalRing.ord_eq_top_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_top_iff {I : Ideal R} : ord I = ⊤ ↔ I = ⊥

name: IsLocalRing.ord_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem ord_eq_zero_iff {I : Ideal R} : ord I = 0 ↔ I = ⊤

name: IsLocalRing.ord_le_ord_map
statement:
theorem ord_le_ord_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] (φ : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (I : Ideal R) : ord I ≤ ord (I.map φ)

name: IsLocalRing.ord_pow_of_ordElem_mul
statement:
theorem ord_pow_of_ordElem_mul (hmul : ∀ f g : R, ordElem (f * g) = ordElem f + ordElem g)
    (I : Ideal R) {c : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) : ord (I ^ c) = (c : ℕ∞) * ord I

name: IsLocalRing.ord_span
statement: theorem ord_span (S : Set R) : ord (Ideal.span S) = ⨅ f ∈ S, ordElem f

name: IsLocalRing.ord_span_singleton_mul_of_ordElem_mul
statement:
theorem ord_span_singleton_mul_of_ordElem_mul
    (hmul : ∀ f g : R, ordElem (f * g) = ordElem f + ordElem g) (f : R) (I : Ideal R) :
    ord (Ideal.span {f} * I) = ordElem f + ord I

name: IsLocalRing.ord_sup
statement: theorem ord_sup (I J : Ideal R) : ord (I ⊔ J) = min (ord I) (ord J)

name: IsLocalRing.ord_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ord_top : ord (⊤ : Ideal R) = 0

name: Ideal.colon_coe_span_singleton_pow
statement:
theorem colon_coe_span_singleton_pow (A : Ideal R) (u : R) (k : ℕ) :
    A.colon (SetLike.coe (Ideal.span {u} ^ k)) = A.colon {u ^ k}

name: Ideal.colon_mul_pow_add
Ideal.colon_pow_pow_mul
statement:
theorem colon_pow_pow_mul (A : Ideal R) {u : R} (hu : u ≠ 0) (k s : ℕ)
    (hA : A ≤ Ideal.span {u ^ k}) :
    (A ^ s).colon {u ^ (k * s)} = A.colon {u ^ k} ^ s

name: Ideal.colon_singleton_pow_mono
statement:
theorem colon_singleton_pow_mono (A : Ideal R) (u : R) {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) :
    A.colon {u ^ s} ≤ A.colon {u ^ t}

name: Ideal.colon_span_pow_mul_self
statement:
theorem colon_span_pow_mul_self (C : Ideal R) {u : R} (hu : u ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    (Ideal.span {u ^ k} * C).colon {u ^ k} = C

name: Ideal.colon_sup_pow
Ideal.span_pow_mul_colon_of_le
statement:
theorem span_pow_mul_colon_of_le (A : Ideal R) (u : R) (a : ℕ) (hA : A ≤ Ideal.span {u ^ a}) :
    Ideal.span {u ^ a} * A.colon {u ^ a} = A

name: IsLocalRing.colon_span_singleton_pow_eq_top_of_ord_le
statement:
theorem colon_span_singleton_pow_eq_top_of_ord_le
    (hmul : ∀ f g : R, ordElem (f * g) =
      ordElem f + ordElem g)
    {u : R} (hu : u ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) {J : Ideal R} {m : ℕ}
    (hle : J ≤ Ideal.span {u} ^ m)
    (hord : ord J ≤ m) : J.colon ↑(Ideal.span {u} ^ m) = ⊤

name: Derivation.eq_localization_of_algebraMap
statement:
theorem eq_localization_of_algebraMap (D' : Derivation k (Localization M) (Localization M))
    (h : ∀ a, D' (algebraMap A (Localization M) a) = algebraMap A (Localization M) (D a)) :
    D' = D.localization M

name: Derivation.localizationFun_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localizationFun_mk (a : A) (s : M) :
    D.localizationFun M (Localization.mk a s) =
      Localization.mk (↑s * D a - a * D ↑s) (s * s)

name: Derivation.localization_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localization_algebraMap (a : A) :
    D.localization M (algebraMap A (Localization M) a) = algebraMap A (Localization M) (D a)

name: Derivation.localization_comm
statement:
theorem localization_comm (D₁ D₂ : Derivation k A A) (h : ∀ a, D₁ (D₂ a) = D₂ (D₁ a))
    (z : Localization M) :
    D₁.localization M (D₂.localization M z) = D₂.localization M (D₁.localization M z)

name: Derivation.localization_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localization_mk (a : A) (s : M) :
    D.localization M (Localization.mk a s) = Localization.mk (↑s * D a - a * D ↑s) (s * s)

name: Derivation.zero_localization
statement: theorem zero_localization : (0 : Derivation k A A).localization M = 0

name: Algebra.exists_unit_mul_eq_of_span_range_eq_span_singleton
statement:
theorem exists_unit_mul_eq_of_span_range_eq_span_singleton {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (z : ι → R) (a : R) (ha : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors R)
    (h : Ideal.span (Set.range z) = Ideal.span {a}) :
    ∃ (i : ι) (u : R), IsUnit u ∧ z i = u * a

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.SpansDerivations.transport
statement:
theorem SpansDerivations.transport (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) (δ : Derivation ℚ R R) (f : R) :
    δ f = ∑ k, δ (x' k) * c.transportPderiv x' k f

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.changeCoords_pderiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeCoords_pderiv (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (hcomm : ∀ i j f, c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)) :
    (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).pderiv = c.transportPderiv x'

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.changeCoords_x
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeCoords_x (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (hcomm : ∀ i j f, c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)) :
    (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).x = x'

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.isUnit_jacobian
statement:
theorem isUnit_jacobian (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) :
    IsUnit (c.jacobian x')

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.jacobian_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem jacobian_apply (x' : Fin n → R) (i j : Fin n) : c.jacobian x' i j = c.pderiv i (x' j)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_pderiv_mem
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_pderiv_mem {y : R} (hy : y ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (h : ∀ i, c.pderiv i y ∈ maximalIdeal R) : y ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.pderiv_eq_sum_transportPderiv
statement:
theorem pderiv_eq_sum_transportPderiv (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) (i : Fin n) :
    c.pderiv i = ∑ j, c.jacobian x' i j • c.transportPderiv x' j

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.span_range_transportPderiv
statement:
theorem span_range_transportPderiv (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range (c.transportPderiv x')) =
      Submodule.span R (Set.range c.pderiv)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.spansDerivations_changeCoords
statement:
theorem spansDerivations_changeCoords (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (hcomm : ∀ i j f, c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)) :
    (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).SpansDerivations ℚ

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transportPderiv_apply
statement:
theorem transportPderiv_apply (x' : Fin n → R) (j : Fin n) (f : R) :
    c.transportPderiv x' j f = ∑ l, (c.jacobian x')⁻¹ j l * c.pderiv l f

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transportPderiv_comm
statement:
theorem transportPderiv_comm (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) (x' : Fin n → R)
    (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x')) (i j : Fin n) (f : R) :
    c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.transportPderiv_x
statement:
theorem transportPderiv_x (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (i j : Fin n) : c.transportPderiv x' i (x' j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.x_mem_maximalIdeal
statement: theorem x_mem_maximalIdeal (i : Fin n) : c.x i ∈ maximalIdeal R

name: IsLocalRing.derivation_sum_apply
statement:
theorem derivation_sum_apply {R A M ι : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Algebra R A] [Module A M] [Module R M] (s : Finset ι)
    (D : ι → Derivation R A M) (a : A) : (∑ i ∈ s, D i) a = ∑ i ∈ s, D i a

name: IsLocalRing.isUnit_natCast
statement: theorem isUnit_natCast {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) : IsUnit (a : R)

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.add_f
statement: @[simp] theorem add_f [Add R] (a b : MarkedElem R) (h : a.m = b.m) : (a.add b h).f = a.f + b.f

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.add_m
statement: @[simp] theorem add_m [Add R] (a b : MarkedElem R) (h : a.m = b.m) : (a.add b h).m = a.m

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.inCosupp_iff_mem_pow
statement: theorem inCosupp_iff_mem_pow (a : MarkedElem R) : a.InCosupp ↔ a.f ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ a.m

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.inCosupp_toMarkedIdeal
statement: theorem inCosupp_toMarkedIdeal (a : MarkedElem R) : a.toMarkedIdeal.InCosupp ↔ a.InCosupp

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def [Mul R] (a b : MarkedElem R) : a * b = ⟨a.f * b.f, a.m + b.m⟩

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.mul_f
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_f [Mul R] (a b : MarkedElem R) : (a * b).f = a.f * b.f

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.mul_m
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_m [Mul R] (a b : MarkedElem R) : (a * b).m = a.m + b.m

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.toMarkedIdeal_I
statement: @[simp] theorem toMarkedIdeal_I (a : MarkedElem R) : a.toMarkedIdeal.I = Ideal.span {a.f}

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.toMarkedIdeal_m
statement: @[simp] theorem toMarkedIdeal_m (a : MarkedElem R) : a.toMarkedIdeal.m = a.m

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedElem.toMarkedIdeal_mul
statement:
theorem toMarkedIdeal_mul (a b : MarkedElem R) :
    (a * b).toMarkedIdeal = a.toMarkedIdeal * b.toMarkedIdeal

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.add_I
statement: @[simp] theorem add_I (J K : MarkedIdeal R) (h : J.m = K.m) : (J.add K h).I = J.I ⊔ K.I

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.add_m
statement: @[simp] theorem add_m (J K : MarkedIdeal R) (h : J.m = K.m) : (J.add K h).m = J.m

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_add_iff
statement:
theorem inCosupp_add_iff {J K : MarkedIdeal R} (h : J.m = K.m) :
    (J.add K h).InCosupp ↔ J.InCosupp ∧ K.InCosupp

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_anti
statement:
theorem inCosupp_anti {I J : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (h : I ≤ J) (hJ : InCosupp ⟨J, m⟩) :
    InCosupp ⟨I, m⟩

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_iff_le_pow
statement: theorem inCosupp_iff_le_pow (J : MarkedIdeal R) : J.InCosupp ↔ J.I ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ J.m

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_mul
statement:
theorem inCosupp_mul {J K : MarkedIdeal R} (hJ : J.InCosupp) (hK : K.InCosupp) :
    (J * K).InCosupp

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_pow
statement:
theorem inCosupp_pow {J : MarkedIdeal R} (c : ℕ) (h : J.InCosupp) :
    InCosupp ⟨J.I ^ c, J.m * c⟩

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.inCosupp_pow_iff_of_ordElem_mul
IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.mul_I
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_I (J K : MarkedIdeal R) : (J * K).I = J.I * K.I

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (J K : MarkedIdeal R) : J * K = ⟨J.I * K.I, J.m + K.m⟩

name: IsLocalRing.MarkedIdeal.mul_m
statement: @[simp] theorem mul_m (J K : MarkedIdeal R) : (J * K).m = J.m + K.m

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_bot
statement: theorem D_bot : c.D ⊥ = ⊥

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_changeCoords
statement:
theorem D_changeCoords (x' : Fin n → R) (hx' : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x'))
    (hcomm : ∀ i j f, c.transportPderiv x' i (c.transportPderiv x' j f) =
      c.transportPderiv x' j (c.transportPderiv x' i f)) (I : Ideal R) :
    (c.changeCoords x' hx' hcomm).D I = c.D I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_eq_top_of_ord_eq_zero
statement: theorem D_eq_top_of_ord_eq_zero {I : Ideal R} (hI : ord I = 0) : c.D I = ⊤

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_finset_prod_le
statement:
theorem D_finset_prod_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (J : ι → Ideal R) :
    c.D (∏ k ∈ s, J k) ≤ ⨆ k ∈ s, c.D (J k) * ∏ l ∈ s.erase k, J l

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_finset_prod_pow_le
statement:
theorem D_finset_prod_pow_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (J : ι → Ideal R) (e : ι → ℕ) (he : ∀ k ∈ s, 1 ≤ e k) :
    c.D (∏ k ∈ s, J k ^ e k) ≤
      ⨆ k ∈ s, c.D (J k) * J k ^ (e k - 1) * ∏ l ∈ s.erase k, J l ^ e l

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_iSup
statement: theorem D_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal R) : c.D (⨆ k, I k) = ⨆ k, c.D (I k)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_le_iff
statement: theorem D_le_iff {I J : Ideal R} : c.D I ≤ J ↔ I ≤ J ∧ ∀ i, ∀ g ∈ I, c.pderiv i g ∈ J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_map
statement:
theorem D_map {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsRegularLocalRing R'] [Algebra ℚ R'] {n' : ℕ}
    (c' : RegularCoords R' n') (φ : R →+* R') (e : Fin n → Fin n')
    (hφ : ∀ i f, c'.pderiv (e i) (φ f) = φ (c.pderiv i f))
    (hφ' : ∀ j, j ∉ Set.range e → ∀ f, c'.pderiv j (φ f) = 0) (I : Ideal R) :
    c'.D (I.map φ) = (c.D I).map φ

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_map_le
statement:
theorem D_map_le {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsRegularLocalRing R'] [Algebra ℚ R'] {n' : ℕ}
    (c' : RegularCoords R' n') (φ : R →+* R') (e : Fin n' → Fin n)
    (hφ : ∀ j f, c'.pderiv j (φ f) = φ (c.pderiv (e j) f)) (I : Ideal R) :
    c'.D (I.map φ) ≤ (c.D I).map φ

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem D_maximalIdeal_pow {a : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
    c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ a) ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ (a - 1)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_maximalIdeal_pow_succ
statement:
theorem D_maximalIdeal_pow_succ (a : ℕ) :
    c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ (a + 1)) ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ a

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_maximalIdeal_pow_zero
statement: theorem D_maximalIdeal_pow_zero : c.D (maximalIdeal R ^ 0) = ⊤

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_mono
statement: theorem D_mono {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : c.D I ≤ c.D J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_mul_le
statement: theorem D_mul_le (I J : Ideal R) : c.D (I * J) ≤ c.D I * J ⊔ I * c.D J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_pow_le
statement: theorem D_pow_le (J : Ideal R) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : c.D (J ^ k) ≤ c.D J * J ^ (k - 1)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_span
statement:
theorem D_span (S : Set R) :
    c.D (Ideal.span S) = Ideal.span (S ∪ ⋃ i, c.pderiv i '' S)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_span_singleton_x_mul_x
statement:
theorem D_span_singleton_x_mul_x {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    c.D (Ideal.span {c.x i * c.x j}) = Ideal.span {c.x i, c.x j}

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_span_singleton_x_pow
statement:
theorem D_span_singleton_x_pow (i : Fin n) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    c.D (Ideal.span {c.x i ^ m}) = Ideal.span {c.x i ^ (m - 1)}

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_sup
statement: theorem D_sup (I J : Ideal R) : c.D (I ⊔ J) = c.D I ⊔ c.D J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_top
statement: theorem D_top : c.D ⊤ = ⊤

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dimg_eq_D
statement: theorem Dimg_eq_D (hs : c.SpansDerivations ℚ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (I : Ideal R) : Dimg I = c.D I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_Dpow
statement: theorem Dpow_Dpow (r s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow r (c.Dpow s I) = c.Dpow (r + s) I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le
statement: theorem Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hord : ord I ≤ m) : c.Dpow m I = ⊤

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le_of_forall
statement:
theorem Dpow_eq_top_of_ord_le_of_forall
    (h74 : ∀ (I : Ideal R) {r m : ℕ}, r < m →
      ((m : ℕ∞) ≤ ord I ↔ ((m - r : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ord (c.Dpow r I)))
    {I : Ideal R} {m : ℕ} (hord : ord I ≤ m) : c.Dpow m I = ⊤

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_map_le
statement:
theorem Dpow_map_le {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsRegularLocalRing R'] [Algebra ℚ R'] {n' : ℕ}
    (c' : RegularCoords R' n') (φ : R →+* R') (e : Fin n' → Fin n)
    (hφ : ∀ j f, c'.pderiv j (φ f) = φ (c.pderiv (e j) f)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c'.Dpow r (I.map φ) ≤ (c.Dpow r I).map φ

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem Dpow_maximalIdeal_pow {r a : ℕ} (h : r ≤ a) :
    c.Dpow r (maximalIdeal R ^ a) ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ (a - r)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_mono
statement: theorem Dpow_mono (r : ℕ) {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : c.Dpow r I ≤ c.Dpow r J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_mono_left
statement: theorem Dpow_mono_left {r r' : ℕ} (h : r ≤ r') (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow r I ≤ c.Dpow r' I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_mul_le
statement:
theorem Dpow_mul_le (r : ℕ) (I J : Ideal R) :
    c.Dpow r (I * J) ≤ ⨆ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), c.Dpow i I * c.Dpow (r - i) J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_one
statement: theorem Dpow_one (I : Ideal R) : c.Dpow 1 I = c.D I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_span
statement:

theorem coe_frac_eq_awayFrac {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {p : ∀ y : Localization.Away a, y ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a → Prop}
    (mem : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ I),
      p (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a) (mul_invSelf_mem hx))
    (algebraMap : ∀ r, p (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) r) (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r))
    (add : ∀ y z hy hz, p y hy → p z hz → p (y + z) (add_mem hy hz))
    (mul : ∀ y z hy hz, p y hy → p z hz → p (y * z) (mul_mem hy hz))
    {y : Localization.Away a} (hy : y ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a) : p y hy

theorem mem_iff (ha : a ∈ I) (y : Localization.Away a) :

theorem mul_invSelf_mem {x : R} (hx : x ∈ I) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mul_invSelf_pow_mem
statement:
theorem mul_invSelf_pow_mem :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {x : R}, x ∈ I ^ n →
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) x * invSelf a ^ n ∈ affineBlowUpAlgebra I a
  | 0, x, _ => by simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]; exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ x
  | n + 1, x, hx => by
    rw [pow_succ'] at hx
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hx (fun m hm k hk => ?_) (fun y z hy hz => ?_)
    · have : algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) (m * k) * invSelf a ^ (n + 1) =
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) m * invSelf a) *
            (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) k * invSelf a ^ n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBlowUpAlgebra.mul_pow_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem mul_pow_of_comp_eq (δ : affineBlowUpAlgebra I f →+* S)
    (hδ : δ.comp (algebraMap R (affineBlowUpAlgebra I f)) = β) (z : affineBlowUpAlgebra I f)
    (x : R) (n : ℕ)
    (hz : (z : Localization.Away f) * algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) f ^ n =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) x) :
    δ z * β f ^ n = β x

name: Derivation.eq_extendAway_of_algebraMap
statement:
theorem eq_extendAway_of_algebraMap (D : Derivation k A A) (a : A)
    (D' : Derivation k (Localization.Away a) (Localization.Away a))
    (h : ∀ f, D' (algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) f) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) (D f)) :
    D' = D.extendAway a

name: Derivation.extendAway_algebraMap
statement:
theorem extendAway_algebraMap (D : Derivation k A A) (a f : A) :
    D.extendAway a (algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) f) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) (D f)

name: Derivation.extendAway_mk
statement:
theorem extendAway_mk (D : Derivation k A A) (a f : A) (m : ℕ) :
    D.extendAway a (Localization.mk f ⟨a ^ m, pow_mem (Submonoid.mem_powers a) m⟩) =
      Localization.mk (a * D f - (m : A) * f * D a)
        ⟨a ^ (m + 1), pow_mem (Submonoid.mem_powers a) (m + 1)⟩

name: Derivation.finset_sum_apply
statement:
theorem finset_sum_apply {ι M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [Module A M]
    (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → Derivation k A M) (z : A) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, D i) z = ∑ i ∈ s, D i z

statement:
theorem awayPderiv_algebraMap (j : Fin n) (a : R) :

statement:

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_chartY_of_lt (j : Fin n) {k : Fin n} (hk : k < r) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (chartY c.x r k) =
      (if j = k then 1 else 0) * invX c.x r -
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away (c.x r)) (c.x k) * invX c.x r ^ 2 *
          (if j = r then 1 else 0)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_chartY_of_not_lt
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_chartY_of_not_lt (j : Fin n) {k : Fin n} (hk : ¬ k < r) :

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.awayPderiv_invX
statement:
theorem awayPderiv_invX (j : Fin n) :
    c.awayPderiv r j (invX c.x r) = -(invX c.x r ^ 2 * if j = r then 1 else 0)

name: IsLocalRing.comap_map_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem comap_map_adicCompletion (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))).comap
      (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) = I

name: IsLocalRing.faithfullyFlat_adicCompletion

theorem faithfullyFlat_adicCompletion :

name: IsLocalRing.isAdicComplete_adicCompletion

theorem isAdicComplete_adicCompletion :

      (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)

name: IsLocalRing.isLocalRing_adicCompletion
statement: theorem isLocalRing_adicCompletion : IsLocalRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)

theorem map_adicCompletion_injective :

      (fun I : Ideal R => I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)))

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_adicCompletion :

name: IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_algebraMap_mem

theorem mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_algebraMap_mem (f : R) (a : ℕ) :

      algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) f ∈

name: IsLocalRing.ord_map_adicCompletion
statement:
theorem ord_map_adicCompletion (I : Ideal R) :
    ord (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))) = ord I

name: IsLocalRing.residueField_map_adicCompletion_bijective
statement:
theorem residueField_map_adicCompletion_bijective :
    Function.Bijective
      (ResidueField.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)))

name: IsLocalRing.exists_comap_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_comap_eq_of_le (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.IsIntegral) (P : PrimeSpectrum A)
    (Q₀ : Ideal B) (hle : Ideal.comap f Q₀ ≤ P.asIdeal) :
    ∃ Q : PrimeSpectrum B, Q₀ ≤ Q.asIdeal ∧ PrimeSpectrum.comap f Q = P

name: IsLocalRing.exists_ltSeries_comap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ltSeries_comap_eq (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.IsIntegral) (hinj : Function.Injective f)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ l : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum A), ∀ hl : l.length = n,
      ∃ (m : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum B)) (hm : m.length = n),
        ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
          PrimeSpectrum.comap f (m (Fin.cast (by rw [hm]) i)) = l (Fin.cast (by rw [hl]) i)

name: IsLocalRing.map_quotientMk_le_jacobson_of_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem map_quotientMk_le_jacobson_of_le_maximalIdeal [IsLocalRing R] (I B : Ideal R)
    (hBm : B ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) B ≤ Ring.jacobson (R ⧸ I)

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_iSup_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_iSup_minimalPrimes (I : Ideal R) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) = ⨆ P ∈ I.minimalPrimes, ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P)

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_krullDim_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_krullDim_zeroLocus (I : Ideal R) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) = Order.krullDim (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (I : Set R))

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical_sup
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical_sup [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {d : ℕ} (I : Ideal R)
    (s : Fin d → R) (hs : ∀ j, s j ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ≤ (I ⊔ Ideal.span (Set.range s)).radical) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_quotient_of_le
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_quotient_of_le {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I)

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_quotient_le_zero_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_le_zero_of_maximalIdeal_le_radical [IsLocalRing R] (J : Ideal R)
    (hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ≤ J.radical) : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) ≤ 0

name: IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_map_span_range_le
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_map_span_range_le {d : ℕ} (I : Ideal R) (g : Fin d → R) :
    (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (Ideal.span (Set.range g))).spanFinrank ≤ d

name: IsLocalRing.exists_localization_coords
statement:
theorem exists_localization_coords :
    ∃ _ : IsRegularLocalRing
      (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))),
      ∃ c' : RegularCoords (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))) r,
        c'.x = (fun i => algebraMap R _ (c.x (Fin.castLE hr i))) ∧
        c'.pderiv = fun i => (c.pderiv (Fin.castLE hr i)).localization
          (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).primeCompl

name: IsLocalRing.image_lt_eq_range
statement:
theorem image_lt_eq_range (hr : r ≤ n) :
    x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r} = Set.range fun i : Fin r => x (Fin.castLE hr i)

name: IsLocalRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_localization_span_image_lt
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hr : r ≤ n) [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))

name: IsLocalRing.localization_pderiv_algebraMap_x
statement:
theorem localization_pderiv_algebraMap_x (i j : Fin r) :
    (c.pderiv (Fin.castLE hr i)).localization
        (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).primeCompl
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (c.x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))
          (c.x (Fin.castLE hr j))) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0

name: IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_localization_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_localization_span_image_lt (hr : r ≤ n)
    [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : Fin r =>
        algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))
          (x (Fin.castLE hr i)))

name: IsLocalRing.natCast_le_height_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem natCast_le_height_span_image_lt (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x))
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R) (hr : r ≤ n) :
    (r : ℕ∞) ≤ (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).height

name: IsLocalRing.natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem natCast_le_ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hr : r ≤ n) [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    (r : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))

name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_localization_span_image_lt
    (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x)) (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R)
    (hr : r ≤ n) [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r}))) = r

name: IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_le
statement:
theorem spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_localization_le (hr : r ≤ n)
    [(Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})).IsPrime] :
    (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span (x '' {j : Fin n | j.val < r})))).spanFinrank
      ≤ r

name: Derivation.quotientLinear_mk
statement:
theorem quotientLinear_mk (hJ : ∀ f ∈ J, D f ∈ J) (f : R) :
    D.quotientLinear J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J f) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (D f)

name: Derivation.quotientOfMapLE_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientOfMapLE_mk (hJ : ∀ f ∈ J, D f ∈ J) (f : R) :
    D.quotientOfMapLE J hJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J f) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (D f)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.card_quotient_span_x
statement: theorem card_quotient_span_x : (k : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ span {c.x i₀})

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.maximalIdeal_quotient_span_x
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_quotient_span_x :
    maximalIdeal (R ⧸ span {c.x i₀}) =
      span (Set.range fun j : Fin k =>
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) (c.x (i₀.succAbove j)))

statement:
theorem pderiv_mem_span_x_of_ne {j : Fin (k + 1)} (hj : j ≠ i₀) {f : R}

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.quotientCoords_pderiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientCoords_pderiv (j : Fin k) :

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.quotientCoords_pderiv_mk
statement:
theorem quotientCoords_pderiv_mk (j : Fin k) (f : R) :

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.quotientCoords_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientCoords_x (j : Fin k) :

statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientPderiv_mk (j : Fin k) (f : R) :
    c.quotientPderiv i₀ j (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) f) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x i₀}) (c.pderiv (i₀.succAbove j) f)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.ringKrullDim_quotient_span_x_add_one
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_span_x_add_one :

statement: @[simp] theorem shiftPerm_succ (j : Fin k) : shiftPerm i₀ j.succ = i₀.succAbove j

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.shiftPerm_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftPerm_zero : shiftPerm i₀ 0 = i₀

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.D_eq_Dlog_sup
statement:
theorem D_eq_Dlog_sup (h : Fin n) (J : Ideal R) :

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_empty
statement: theorem DlogE_empty (I : Ideal R) : c.DlogE ∅ I = c.D I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_eq_iSup_logDerE
statement:
theorem DlogE_eq_iSup_logDerE (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : Ideal R) :

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_iSup
statement:
theorem DlogE_iSup {ι : Sort*} (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : ι → Ideal R) :
    c.DlogE E (⨆ k, I k) = ⨆ k, c.DlogE E (I k)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_le_D
statement: theorem DlogE_le_D (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : Ideal R) : c.DlogE E I ≤ c.D I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_le_iff
statement:
theorem DlogE_le_iff {E : Finset (Fin n)} {I J : Ideal R} :
    c.DlogE E I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ J ∧ (∀ i ∈ E, ∀ f ∈ I, c.x i * c.pderiv i f ∈ J) ∧
        ∀ j, j ∉ E → ∀ f ∈ I, c.pderiv j f ∈ J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_mono
statement: theorem DlogE_mono {E : Finset (Fin n)} {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) : c.DlogE E I ≤ c.DlogE E J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_span_x_self
statement:
theorem DlogE_span_x_self {E : Finset (Fin n)} {h : Fin n} (hh : h ∈ E) :
    c.DlogE E (Ideal.span {c.x h}) = Ideal.span {c.x h}

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogE_sup
statement:
theorem DlogE_sup (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I J : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogE E (I ⊔ J) = c.DlogE E I ⊔ c.DlogE E J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_add
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_add (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r (c.DlogEpow E s I) = c.DlogEpow E (r + s) I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_empty
statement: theorem DlogEpow_empty (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.DlogEpow ∅ r I = c.Dpow r I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_iSup
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_iSup {ι : Sort*} (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : ι → Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r (⨆ k, I k) = ⨆ k, c.DlogEpow E r (I k)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_le_Dpow
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_le_Dpow (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r I ≤ c.Dpow r I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_mono
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_mono {E : Finset (Fin n)} (r : ℕ) {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) :
    c.DlogEpow E r I ≤ c.DlogEpow E r J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_mono_left
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_mono_left {E : Finset (Fin n)} {r s : ℕ} (h : r ≤ s) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r I ≤ c.DlogEpow E s I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_succ
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_succ (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E (r + 1) I = c.DlogE E (c.DlogEpow E r I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_succ'
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_succ' (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E (r + 1) I = c.DlogEpow E r (c.DlogE E I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_sup
statement:
theorem DlogEpow_sup (E : Finset (Fin n)) (r : ℕ) (I J : Ideal R) :
    c.DlogEpow E r (I ⊔ J) = c.DlogEpow E r I ⊔ c.DlogEpow E r J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.DlogEpow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem DlogEpow_zero (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : Ideal R) : c.DlogEpow E 0 I = I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlog_eq_iSup_logDer
statement:
theorem Dlog_eq_iSup_logDer (h : Fin n) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlog h I = I ⊔ ⨆ δ ∈ c.logDer h, Ideal.span (δ '' I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlog_le_iff
statement:
theorem Dlog_le_iff (h : Fin n) {I J : Ideal R} :
    c.Dlog h I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ J ∧ (∀ f ∈ I, c.x h * c.pderiv h f ∈ J) ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ h → ∀ f ∈ I, c.pderiv j f ∈ J

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlog_map_quotient
statement:
theorem Dlog_map_quotient (J : Ideal R) :
    (c.Dlog h J).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x h})) =
      (c.quotientCoords h).D (J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x h})))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_Dpow_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_Dpow_eq_iSup (h : Fin n) {s j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ s) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I) = ⨆ i ≤ j, c.Dlogpow h (s - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h i I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_Dpow_le
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_Dpow_le (h : Fin n) {s j : ℕ} (hj : j < s) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I) ≤ c.Dlogpow h (s - (j + 1)) (c.Dpow (j + 1) I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_Dpow_le_iSup
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_Dpow_le_iSup (h : Fin n) (j : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    ∀ s, j ≤ s → c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I) ≤
      ⨆ i ≤ j, c.Dlogpow h (s - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h i I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_Dpow_le_of_le
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_Dpow_le_of_le (h : Fin n) {s i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ s) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (s - i) (c.Dpow i I) ≤ c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_le_Dpow
statement: theorem Dlogpow_le_Dpow (h : Fin n) (s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dlogpow h s I ≤ c.Dpow s I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_map_quotient
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_map_quotient (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    (c.Dlogpow h r I).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x h})) =
      (c.quotientCoords h).Dpow r (I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (span {c.x h})))

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_succ
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_succ (h : Fin n) (r : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (r + 1) I = c.Dlog h (c.Dlogpow h r I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_succ_le
statement:
theorem Dlogpow_succ_le (h : Fin n) (s : ℕ) (J : Ideal R) :
    c.Dlogpow h (s + 1) J ≤ c.Dlogpow h s (c.D J)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dlogpow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Dlogpow_zero (h : Fin n) (I : Ideal R) : c.Dlogpow h 0 I = I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.Dpow_eq_sum_Dlogpow
statement:
theorem Dpow_eq_sum_Dlogpow (h : Fin n) (s : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iSup_Dlogpow_iterPderivIdeal_le
statement:
theorem iSup_Dlogpow_iterPderivIdeal_le (h : Fin n) {s j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ s) (I : Ideal R) :
    ⨆ i ≤ j, c.Dlogpow h (s - i) (c.iterPderivIdeal h i I) ≤ c.Dlogpow h (s - j) (c.Dpow j I)

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderivIdeal_le_Dpow
statement:
theorem iterPderivIdeal_le_Dpow (h : Fin n) (j : ℕ) (I : Ideal R) :
    c.iterPderivIdeal h j I ≤ c.Dpow j I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterPderivIdeal_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem iterPderivIdeal_zero (h : Fin n) (I : Ideal R) : c.iterPderivIdeal h 0 I = I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.iterate_pderiv_mem_Dpow
statement:
theorem iterate_pderiv_mem_Dpow (h : Fin n) {I : Ideal R} {f : R} (hf : f ∈ I) (j : ℕ) :
    (⇑(c.pderiv h))^[j] f ∈ c.Dpow j I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_DlogE
statement: theorem le_DlogE (E : Finset (Fin n)) (I : Ideal R) : I ≤ c.DlogE E I

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.le_DlogEpow

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.logDerE_eq_span
statement:
theorem logDerE_eq_span (E : Finset (Fin n)) :

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.logDer_eq_span
statement:
theorem logDer_eq_span (h : Fin n) :
    c.logDer h = Submodule.span R ({c.x h • c.pderiv h} ∪ c.pderiv '' {j | j ≠ h})

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_derivStable
statement:
theorem mem_derivStable {δ : Derivation ℚ R R} {K : Ideal R} {f : R} :
    f ∈ derivStable δ K ↔ f ∈ K ∧ δ f ∈ K

name: IsLocalRing.RegularCoords.mem_logDerE
statement:
theorem mem_logDerE {E : Finset (Fin n)} {δ : Derivation ℚ R R} :
    δ ∈ c.logDerE E ↔

statement:
theorem IsRegularLocalRing.exists_span_eq_maximalIdeal_and_eq_span_image_lt [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) [IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ I)] :
    ∃ (n c : ℕ) (x : Fin n → R), c ≤ n ∧ (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R ∧
      maximalIdeal R = span (Set.range x) ∧ I = span (x '' {j | j.val < c})

      maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range x) ∧ I = Ideal.span (x '' {j | j.val < c}) ∧
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) + (c : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R

name: IsLocalRing.exists_cons_regularSystem_common
statement:
theorem exists_cons_regularSystem_common {d : ℕ} (z : Fin (d + 1) → R)
    (hz : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range z)) (p₀ : Fin (d + 1)) (T : Set (Fin (d + 1)))
    (hT : p₀ ∉ T) (x' : R) (hx' : x' ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (d + 1)) (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R))
    (hb : ∀ i, b i = (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨z i, mem_maximalIdeal_of_eq_span hz i⟩)
    (hv : (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨x', hx'⟩ ∉
      Submodule.span (ResidueField R) (b '' T)) :
    ∃ y : Fin d → R, (∀ i ∈ T, ∃ j, y j = z i) ∧
      maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range (Fin.cons (z p₀) y)) ∧
      maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span (Set.range (Fin.cons x' y))

      ∀ i ∈ insert i₀ t, β i ∈ F⟮∑ j ∈ insert i₀ t, ϕ (c j) • β j⟯

name: Analytic.exists_linear_primitive_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_linear_primitive_of_isIntegral [CharZero F] {C : Type*} [Field C]
    (ϕ : C →+* F) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (β : ι → E) (hβ : ∀ i ∈ s, IsIntegral F (β i))
    {i₀ : ι} (hi₀ : i₀ ∈ s) :
    ∃ c : ι → C, c i₀ = 1 ∧ (∀ i, i ∉ s → c i = 0) ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, β i ∈ F⟮∑ j ∈ s, ϕ (c j) • β j⟯

name: Analytic.exists_linear_primitive_relations
statement:
theorem exists_linear_primitive_relations (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.Finite)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) (hC : ∀ c, f (algebraMap C R c) = algebraMap C S c)
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (ξ : ι → S) {i₀ : ι} (hi₀ : i₀ ∈ s) :
    ∃ c : ι → C, c i₀ = 1 ∧ (∀ i, i ∉ s → c i = 0) ∧
      ∃ Q : R[X], Q.Monic ∧ Irreducible Q ∧
        eval₂ f (∑ j ∈ s, algebraMap C S (c j) * ξ j) Q = 0 ∧
        ∃ A : R, A ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ B : R[X],
          f A * ξ i = eval₂ f (∑ j ∈ s, algebraMap C S (c j) * ξ j) B

    (hder : HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ₂ (u₀, t)) c t₀) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∃ τ : (Fin d → ℂ) → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ τ u₀ ∧ τ u₀ = t₀ ∧ (∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 u₀, Φ₂ (u, τ u) = 0) ∧

    (hE₂ : ∀ p ∈ S₂, IsClosed (E₂ p)) (hK₂ : ∀ p ∈ S₂, Disjoint (K p.1 ×ˢ K p.2) (E₂ p))
    (hfin₂ : ∀ i, {p ∈ S₂ | p.1 = i ∨ p.2 = i}.Finite)
    (S₃ : Set (ι × ι × ι)) (E₃ : ∀ t : ι × ι × ι, Set (Y t.1 × Y t.2.1 × Y t.2.2))
    (hE₃ : ∀ t ∈ S₃, IsClosed (E₃ t))
    (hK₃ : ∀ t ∈ S₃, Disjoint (K t.1 ×ˢ K t.2.1 ×ˢ K t.2.2) (E₃ t))
    (hfin₃ : ∀ i, {t ∈ S₃ | t.1 = i ∨ t.2.1 = i ∨ t.2.2 = i}.Finite) :
    ∃ A : ∀ i, Set (Y i), (∀ i, IsOpen (A i)) ∧ (∀ i, K i ⊆ A i) ∧

statement:
theorem exists_affineEmbedding (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsAffine X] :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (emb : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial (Fin N) k))),
      IsClosedImmersion emb ∧
        emb ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial (Fin N) k))) =
          X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) ∧
        ∀ η ∈ genericPoints X,
          2 ≤ ringKrullDim
            ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial (Fin N) k))).presheaf.stalk (emb η))

name: Hironaka.Resolution.exists_affineEmbedding_aux
statement:
theorem exists_affineEmbedding_aux (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsAffine X] :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (emb : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial (Fin N) k))),
      IsClosedImmersion emb ∧
        emb ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial (Fin N) k))) =
          X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) ∧
        ∀ x : X, 2 ≤ ringKrullDim
          ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial (Fin N) k))).presheaf.stalk (emb x))

      ∃ P ∈ S, ∃ T₁, (T₁ = ∅ ∨ T₁ ∈ N) ∧ T₁ ∪ P ∈ N ∧ (∀ Q ∈ S, ¬ Q ⊆ T₁) ∧

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.lex_map_iff
statement:
theorem lex_map_iff {f : ℕ → ℕ} {A : Set ℕ} (hf : StrictMonoOn f A) :
    ∀ {l l' : List ℕ}, (∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ A) → (∀ x ∈ l', x ∈ A) →
      (List.Lex (· < ·) (l.map f) (l'.map f) ↔ List.Lex (· < ·) l l')
  | [], [], _, _ => ⟨(fun h => nomatch h), (fun h => nomatch h)⟩
  | [], _ :: _, _, _ => ⟨fun _ => List.Lex.nil, fun _ => List.Lex.nil⟩
  | _ :: _, [], _, _ => ⟨(fun h => nomatch h), (fun h => nomatch h)⟩
  | a :: l, b :: l', hl, hl' => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, lex_cons_cons_iff]
    have ha : a ∈ A

statement:
theorem total_le_maxTotal_of_mem_blowUp_faces {s : ℕ} {T : Finset ℕ}
    (hT : T ∈ (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).faces s) :
    (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total T ≤ st.maxTotal s ∧
    ((st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total T = st.maxTotal s →
      T ∈ st.faces s ∧ st.total T = st.maxTotal s ∧ T ∉ st.choice r)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.total_newFace_lt
statement:
theorem total_newFace_lt (hs : ∀ s < r, st.Star s) (hP : P ∈ st.choice r)
    (hT₁ : T₁ ∪ P ∈ st.nerve) (hc : c ∈ P) (hcT₁ : c ∉ T₁) :
    insert c T₁ ∈ st.nerve ∧
    (insert c T₁).card = (insert (st.newComp (st.choice r) P) T₁).card ∧
    (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total (insert (st.newComp (st.choice r) P) T₁) + st.m =
      st.total (insert c T₁) + st.total (P.erase c) ∧
    st.total (P.erase c) < st.m ∧
    (st.blowUp (st.choice r)).total (insert (st.newComp (st.choice r) P) T₁) <
      st.total (insert c T₁)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_restrict
statement:
theorem phase_restrict (r : ℕ) : ∀ (N : MonomialState) (hsN : ∀ s < r, N.Star s)
    (D P : MonomialState) (ρ σ : ℕ → ℕ), Rel ρ σ D P → Sub P N →
    ∀ hsD : ∀ s < r, D.Star s,
    ∃ ρ' σ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < D.nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) ∧ (∀ ℓ, ℓ < D.nextLabel → σ' ℓ = σ ℓ) ∧
      Rel ρ' σ' (phase r D hsD).1 ((phase r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) ∧
      Sub ((phase r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) (phase r N hsN).1 ∧
      (phase r D hsD).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) =
        restrictRun P (phase r N hsN).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_restrict
statement:
theorem phases_restrict (k : ℕ) : ∀ (r : ℕ) (N : MonomialState) (hsN : ∀ s < r, N.Star s)
    (D P : MonomialState) (ρ σ : ℕ → ℕ), Rel ρ σ D P → Sub P N → ∀ hsD : ∀ s < r, D.Star s,
    ∃ ρ' σ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < D.nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) ∧ (∀ ℓ, ℓ < D.nextLabel → σ' ℓ = σ ℓ) ∧
      Rel ρ' σ' (phases k r D hsD).1 ((phases k r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) ∧
      Sub ((phases k r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) (phases k r N hsN).1 ∧
      (phases k r D hsD).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) =
        restrictRun P (phases k r N hsN).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_restrict
statement:
theorem step3_restrict {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) :
    ∃ ρ : ℕ ↪o ℕ, (∀ c, c < L.nextComp → ρ c = c) ∧
      ∃ σ : ℕ ↪o ℕ, (∀ ℓ, ℓ < L.nextLabel → σ ℓ = ℓ) ∧
        (∀ c, c < (step3 L).1.nextComp →
          ((step3 N).2.foldl blowUp L).a (ρ c) = (step3 L).1.a c ∧
          ((step3 N).2.foldl blowUp L).label (ρ c) = σ ((step3 L).1.label c)) ∧
        ((step3 N).2.foldl blowUp L).nerve = (step3 L).1.nerve.image (Finset.image ρ) ∧
        (step3 L).2.map (fun S : Finset (Finset ℕ) => S.image (Finset.image ρ)) =
          restrictRun L (step3 N).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_restrict_aux
statement:
theorem step3_restrict_aux {L N : MonomialState} (h : Sub L N) :
    ∃ ρ' σ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < L.nextComp → ρ' c = c) ∧ (∀ ℓ, ℓ < L.nextLabel → σ' ℓ = ℓ) ∧
      Rel ρ' σ' (step3 L).1 ((step3 N).2.foldl blowUp L) ∧
      (step3 L).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) = restrictRun L (step3 N).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_refine
statement:
theorem phase_refine (r : ℕ) : ∀ (L : MonomialState) (hsL : ∀ s < r, L.Star s) (Y : MonomialState)
    (ρ : ℕ → ℕ), Refines ρ Y L → ∀ hsY : ∀ s < r, Y.Star s,
    ∃ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < Y.nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) ∧
      Refines ρ' (phase r Y hsY).1 (phase r L hsL).1 ∧
      (phase r L hsL).2 = (phase r Y hsY).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) ∧
      (phase r Y hsY).2 = refineRun ρ' Y (phase r L hsL).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_refine
statement:
theorem phases_refine (k : ℕ) : ∀ (r : ℕ) (L : MonomialState) (hsL : ∀ s < r, L.Star s)
    (Y : MonomialState) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ), Refines ρ Y L → ∀ hsY : ∀ s < r, Y.Star s,
    ∃ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < Y.nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) ∧
      Refines ρ' (phases k r Y hsY).1 (phases k r L hsL).1 ∧
      (phases k r L hsL).2 = (phases k r Y hsY).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) ∧
      (phases k r Y hsY).2 = refineRun ρ' Y (phases k r L hsL).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.refineRun_append
statement:
theorem refineRun_append (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (st : MonomialState) (L₁ L₂ : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))) :
    refineRun ρ st (L₁ ++ L₂) =
      refineRun ρ st L₁ ++ refineRun ρ ((refineRun ρ st L₁).foldl blowUp st) L₂

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.refineRun_congr
statement:
theorem refineRun_congr {ρ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ} : ∀ (st : MonomialState) (Ls : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))),
    (∀ c, c < ((refineRun ρ st Ls).foldl blowUp st).nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) →
    refineRun ρ' st Ls = refineRun ρ st Ls
  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | st, S' :: Ls, hρ => by
    have hfil : (st.nerve.filter fun Q => Q.image ρ' ∈ S') =
        st.nerve.filter fun Q => Q.image ρ ∈ S'

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.refineRun_cons
statement:
theorem refineRun_cons (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (st : MonomialState) (S' : Finset (Finset ℕ))
    (Ls : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))) :
    refineRun ρ st (S' :: Ls) = (st.nerve.filter fun Q => Q.image ρ ∈ S') ::
      refineRun ρ (st.blowUp (st.nerve.filter fun Q => Q.image ρ ∈ S')) Ls

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.refineRun_getElem?
statement:
theorem refineRun_getElem? (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (st : MonomialState) (Ls : List (Finset (Finset ℕ)))
    (k : ℕ) :
    (refineRun ρ st Ls)[k]? = (Ls[k]?).map fun S' : Finset (Finset ℕ) =>
      (((refineRun ρ st Ls).take k).foldl blowUp st).nerve.filter fun Q : Finset ℕ =>
        Q.image ρ ∈ S'

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.refineRun_nil
statement: theorem refineRun_nil (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (st : MonomialState) : refineRun ρ st [] = []

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_refine
statement:
theorem step3_refine {ρ : ℕ → ℕ} {Y L : MonomialState} (h : Refines ρ Y L) :
    ∃ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < Y.nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) ∧
      Refines ρ' (step3 Y).1 (step3 L).1 ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, (step3 L).2[k]? =
        ((step3 Y).2[k]?).map fun S : Finset (Finset ℕ) => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, (step3 Y).2[k]? = ((step3 L).2[k]?).map fun S' : Finset (Finset ℕ) =>
        (((step3 Y).2.take k).foldl blowUp Y).nerve.filter fun Q : Finset ℕ =>
          Q.image ρ' ∈ S'

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_refine_aux
statement:
theorem step3_refine_aux {ρ : ℕ → ℕ} {Y L : MonomialState} (h : Refines ρ Y L) :
    ∃ ρ' : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ c, c < Y.nextComp → ρ' c = ρ c) ∧
      Refines ρ' (step3 Y).1 (step3 L).1 ∧
      (step3 L).2 = (step3 Y).2.map (fun S => S.image (Finset.image ρ')) ∧
      (step3 Y).2 = refineRun ρ' Y (step3 L).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.chainMap_append
statement:
theorem chainMap_append (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ (Y L : MonomialState) (N₁ N₂ : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))),
    chainMap ρ Y L (N₁ ++ N₂) =
      chainMap (chainMap ρ Y L N₁) (chainStateY ρ Y L N₁) (N₁.foldl blowUp L) N₂
  | _, _, [], _ => rfl
  | Y, L, S :: N₁, N₂ => by
    rw [List.cons_append, chainMap_cons, chainMap_cons, chainStateY_cons, List.foldl_cons]
    exact chainMap_append _ _ _ N₁ N₂

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.chainMap_cons
statement:
theorem chainMap_cons (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (Y L : MonomialState) (S : Finset (Finset ℕ))
    (Ns : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))) :
    chainMap ρ Y L (S :: Ns) =
      chainMap (extendComp ρ Y L (Y.nerve.filter fun Q => Q.image ρ ∈ S) S)
        (Y.blowUp (Y.nerve.filter fun Q => Q.image ρ ∈ S)) (L.blowUp S) Ns

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.chainMap_nil
statement: theorem chainMap_nil (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (Y L : MonomialState) : chainMap ρ Y L [] = ρ

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.chainRun_append
statement:
theorem chainRun_append (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ (Y L : MonomialState) (N₁ N₂ : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))),
    chainRun ρ Y L (N₁ ++ N₂) =
      chainRun ρ Y L N₁ ++
        chainRun (chainMap ρ Y L N₁) (chainStateY ρ Y L N₁) (N₁.foldl blowUp L) N₂
  | _, _, [], _ => rfl
  | Y, L, S :: N₁, N₂ => by
    rw [List.cons_append, chainRun_cons, chainRun_cons, chainMap_cons, chainStateY_cons,
      List.foldl_cons, List.cons_append]
    exact congrArg _ (chainRun_append _ _ _ N₁ N₂)

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.chainRun_cons
statement:
theorem chainRun_cons (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (Y L : MonomialState) (S : Finset (Finset ℕ))

statement:
theorem chainStateY_append (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∀ (Y L : MonomialState) (N₁ N₂ : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))),

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_chain
statement:
theorem phase_chain (r : ℕ) : ∀ (L : MonomialState) (hsL : ∀ s < r, L.Star s) (Y : MonomialState)
    (ρ : ℕ → ℕ), Refines ρ Y L → ∀ hsY : ∀ s < r, Y.Star s,
    Refines (chainMap ρ Y L (phase r L hsL).2) (phase r Y hsY).1 (phase r L hsL).1 ∧
      (phase r Y hsY).2 = chainRun ρ Y L (phase r L hsL).2 ∧
      (phase r Y hsY).1 = chainStateY ρ Y L (phase r L hsL).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_chain
statement:
theorem phases_chain (k : ℕ) : ∀ (r : ℕ) (L : MonomialState) (hsL : ∀ s < r, L.Star s)
    (Y : MonomialState) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ), Refines ρ Y L → ∀ hsY : ∀ s < r, Y.Star s,
    Refines (chainMap ρ Y L (phases k r L hsL).2) (phases k r Y hsY).1 (phases k r L hsL).1 ∧
      (phases k r Y hsY).2 = chainRun ρ Y L (phases k r L hsL).2 ∧
      (phases k r Y hsY).1 = chainStateY ρ Y L (phases k r L hsL).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.step3_chain
statement:
theorem step3_chain {ρ : ℕ → ℕ} {Y L : MonomialState} (h : Refines ρ Y L) :

      (step3 Y).2 = chainRun ρ Y L (step3 L).2 ∧ (step3 Y).1 = chainStateY ρ Y L (step3 L).2

    (h₂ : IsChainE (chainMapE ρ Y N N₁) (chainStateYE ρ Y N N₁) (N₁.foldl blowUp N) N₂) :

statement:
theorem Rel.image_mem_image_iff {ρ σ : ℕ → ℕ} {D P : MonomialState} (h : Rel ρ σ D P)
    {T : Finset ℕ} (hT : ∀ c ∈ T, c < D.nextComp) {A : Finset (Finset ℕ)} (hA : A ⊆ D.nerve) :

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.chainMapE_append
statement:
theorem chainMapE_append (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ (Y N : MonomialState) (N₁ N₂ : List (Finset (Finset ℕ))),
    chainMapE ρ Y N (N₁ ++ N₂) =
      chainMapE (chainMapE ρ Y N N₁) (chainStateYE ρ Y N N₁) (N₁.foldl blowUp N) N₂
  | _, _, [], _ => rfl
  | Y, N, S :: N₁, N₂ => by
    rw [List.cons_append, List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases h : (Y.nerve.filter fun Q => Q.image ρ ∈ S) = ∅
    · rw [chainMapE_cons_of_eq_empty _ _ _ _ h, chainMapE_cons_of_eq_empty _ _ _ _ h,
        chainStateYE_cons_of_eq_empty _ _ _ _ h]
      exact chainMapE_append ρ Y (N.blowUp S) N₁ N₂
    · rw [chainMapE_cons_of_ne_empty _ _ _ _ h, chainMapE_cons_of_ne_empty _ _ _ _ h,
        chainStateYE_cons_of_ne_empty _ _ _ _ h]
      exact chainMapE_append _ _ _ N₁ N₂

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.chainRunE_append
statement:

    rw [List.cons_append, List.foldl_cons]

    · rw [chainRunE_cons_of_ne_empty _ _ _ _ h, chainRunE_cons_of_ne_empty _ _ _ _ h,

statement:

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phase_chainE
statement:
theorem phase_chainE (r : ℕ) : ∀ (N : MonomialState) (hsN : ∀ s < r, N.Star s)
    (Y D P : MonomialState) (ρY ρ' σ' ρ : ℕ → ℕ), Refines ρY Y D → Rel ρ' σ' D P → Sub P N →
    (∀ c, c < Y.nextComp → ρ c = ρ' (ρY c)) →
    ∀ (hsD : ∀ s < r, D.Star s) (hsY : ∀ s < r, Y.Star s),
    ∃ ρY' ρ'' σ'' : ℕ → ℕ,
      Refines ρY' (phase r Y hsY).1 (phase r D hsD).1 ∧
      Rel ρ'' σ'' (phase r D hsD).1 ((phase r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) ∧
      Sub ((phase r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) (phase r N hsN).1 ∧
      (∀ c, c < (phase r Y hsY).1.nextComp →
        chainMapE ρ Y N (phase r N hsN).2 c = ρ'' (ρY' c)) ∧
      IsChainE ρ Y N (phase r N hsN).2 ∧
      (phase r Y hsY).2 = chainRunE ρ Y N (phase r N hsN).2 ∧
      (phase r Y hsY).1 = chainStateYE ρ Y N (phase r N hsN).2

name: Hironaka.Monomial.MonomialState.phases_chainE
statement:
theorem phases_chainE (k : ℕ) : ∀ (r : ℕ) (N : MonomialState) (hsN : ∀ s < r, N.Star s)
    (Y D P : MonomialState) (ρY ρ' σ' ρ : ℕ → ℕ), Refines ρY Y D → Rel ρ' σ' D P → Sub P N →
    (∀ c, c < Y.nextComp → ρ c = ρ' (ρY c)) →
    ∀ (hsD : ∀ s < r, D.Star s) (hsY : ∀ s < r, Y.Star s),
    ∃ ρY' ρ'' σ'' : ℕ → ℕ,
      Refines ρY' (phases k r Y hsY).1 (phases k r D hsD).1 ∧
      Rel ρ'' σ'' (phases k r D hsD).1 ((phases k r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) ∧
      Sub ((phases k r N hsN).2.foldl blowUp P) (phases k r N hsN).1 ∧
      (∀ c, c < (phases k r Y hsY).1.nextComp →
        chainMapE ρ Y N (phases k r N hsN).2 c = ρ'' (ρY' c)) ∧
      IsChainE ρ Y N (phases k r N hsN).2 ∧
      (phases k r Y hsY).2 = chainRunE ρ Y N (phases k r N hsN).2 ∧
      (phases k r Y hsY).1 = chainStateYE ρ Y N (phases k r N hsN).2

    (V : Y.affineOpens) (hy : y ∈ V.1) (e : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) :
    ((I.comap f).ideal V).map (Y.presheaf.germ V.1 y hy).hom =
      ((I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (f y) (e hy)).hom).map (f.stalkMap y).hom

statement:
theorem span_germ_appLE_eq_iff_of_isOpenImmersion (I : X.IdealSheafData) (j : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (y : Y) (U : X.affineOpens) (V : Y.affineOpens) (hy : y ∈ V.1)
    (e : V.1 ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    Ideal.span {Y.presheaf.germ V.1 y hy (j.appLE U.1 V.1 e a)} =
        ((I.comap j).ideal V).map (Y.presheaf.germ V.1 y hy).hom ↔
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) (e hy) a} =
        (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 (j y) (e hy)).hom

    (e : affineBlowUpAlgebra (coordinateIdeal A S) (X (R := A) j) ≃ₐ[A] MvPolynomial σ A)
    (h₁ : ∀ i ∈ S, i ≠ j → ∀ hi : (X i : MvPolynomial σ A) ∈ coordinateIdeal A S,
      e (frac hi) = X (R := A) i)
    (h₂ : ∀ i ∈ S, i ≠ j →
      e (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ (X (R := A) i)) = X (R := A) i * X (R := A) j)
    (h₃ : e (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ (X (R := A) j)) = X (R := A) j)
    (h₄ : ∀ i ∉ S, e (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) _ (X (R := A) i)) = X (R := A) i) :
    e = coordinateSubspaceEquiv A S j

name: Hironaka.Examples.Theorem88.mem_of_pderiv_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_of_pderiv_eq_one {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B] (D : Derivation ℚ B B)
    {y : B} (hy : D y = 1) (u : B) : u = D (y * u) - y * D u

name: Hironaka.Examples.Theorem88.span_le_ker
statement:
theorem span_le_ker :
    Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X 1 * (MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ 2),
        2 * MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ 2, MvPolynomial.X 2 * MvPolynomial.X 1} ≤
      RingHom.ker (φ : ChartPoly →+* TruncPoly)

name: Hironaka.Examples.Theorem88.transformElem_not_mem
statement:
theorem transformElem_not_mem :
    (MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ 2 : ChartPoly) ∉
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X 1 * (MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ 2),
        2 * MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 2 ^ 2, MvPolynomial.X 2 * MvPolynomial.X 1}
